**You wake up in a strange glass room. After a few seconds, you try to move, but you also notice that you're tied up to what seems to be a chair, as your arms are in your back.**

**But when you try to do something, you hear a sliding door opening in front of you, and then, some loud heels knocking against the concrete floor wore by none other than your boss, Yuki Yamazaki. The sounds of heels are coming closer and closer, before you feel a hand on your thigh, slowly sliding upwards to your crotch, feeling what was hiding here. And then, Yuki sits back on the glass table in front of you and smiles softly her sweet feminine voice fills up your ears as she presses a button and the metal shackles holding you to the chair snap open to free you.**


"Greetings, agent. Sorry for the bumpy ride, my bodyguards lack a little... Professionalism."
